messages:
rhea: short proposal: add an "enforcement preview" flow in Console + small SDK helpers so teams can opt-in to policy-tagging before we flip defaults. telemetry-first then opt-in then warn->flip.
cale: +1. Console preview should run a historical replay and show per-tenant delta (tokens + %). important for customers with mixed dedicated/fallback pools.
toni: SDK notes: py/ts will get a non-breaking helper `client.routing.attachPolicy({})` and `flush_policy()` for CLI use. go will read `RW_POLICY_MODE` env for infra-only toggles. document precedence: explicit API > env var > legacy implicit.
rhea: telemetry idea: `policy.enforcement.preview` events with fields: tenant_id (internal), sdk, policy_present, estimated_tokens, resolved_route, sample 1% global, 10% canary. NO user PII.
sre-bot: scheduled canary: policy-decoder v2 on canary cluster 2024-09-01T06:00Z (job 13221).
cale: rollout phasing: 1) telemetry only (2w), 2) SDK helpers + console preview (2w opt-in), 3) warn-by-default in SDKs + console banner (2w), 4) flip default with per-tenant opt-out window (2w).
toni: gotcha: short-lived processes (Lambda/CLI) need eager handshake. will add `policy_mode='eager'` option in py/ts and a sync `flush_policy()` call. add example in quickstart.
rhea: Console UX: "Enforcement preview" button, modal shows per-bucket delta, confidence band, and an action to pin tag->quota mapping. add a small note about proxies that may strip headers.
sre-bot: rollback guardrail: if any tenant sees >7% sustained mismatch between billed and predicted tokens for 48h after flip, auto-disable enforcement for that tenant and page SRE. automation PR needed.
toni: also propose a tiny E2E test that replays canary traffic and asserts `policy_present` events are ingested and route mapping matches expected buckets within 2%.
ops-bot: FYI: canary deploy started for client SDK helper packages at 2024-08-28T11:00Z.
cale: sampling tweak: start canary at 10% sampling for detailed mapping, drop to 0.5% after 2 weeks. track `policy_sent_but_missing` when SDK reports sending but router doesn't see a header. this helps detect gateway scrubbing.
rhea: action items: 1) toni: open py/ts/go helper PRs + flush API, 2) cale: Console preview mock + replay endpoint spec, 3) rhea: RFC + telemetry schema + sampling, 4) SRE: automation for rollback thresholds. i'll schedule sync next Tue.
toni: PR for python helper opened: https://git.redwood/redwood/py-client/pull/1210 WIP. includes unit tests for eager init.
cale: will upload Console mock and a small migration FAQ. will add "Estimate bill delta" CTA copy.
rhea: thanks all. small, careful rollout and we should avoid surprises. :thumbsup:
